questions.title: Comprehensive Microservices Architecture
questions.question:
Design a comprehensive microservices architecture for an e-commerce platform.

Services:
- User Service: registration, authentication, profile
- Product Service: catalog, inventory, search
- Cart Service: shopping cart management
- Order Service: order creation, order history
- Payment Service: payment processing, refunds
- Shipping Service: shipping calculation, tracking
- Notification Service: emails, SMS, push notifications
- Review Service: product reviews, ratings
- Recommendation Service: ML-based recommendations

Requirements:
- 1M active users, 10K orders/day
- High availability (99.99%)
- Independent deployment of services
- Handle payment failures and order rollback
- Real-time inventory updates
- Personalized recommendations
- Event-driven for notifications
- Multi-region deployment

Design should cover:
1. Service boundaries and responsibilities
2. Database per service design
3. Inter-service communication (sync vs async)
4. API Gateway configuration
5. Service discovery and load balancing
6. Distributed transaction handling (Saga pattern)
7. Event-driven architecture for notifications
8. Circuit breaker and resilience patterns
9. Distributed tracing and logging
10. Configuration management
11. Authentication and authorization flow
12. Deployment strategy (Kubernetes)
13. Monitoring and alerting
14. Scaling strategy per service

Include: architecture diagram, service APIs, event schemas, deployment manifests, and failure scenarios.
